entries.name: ## General description
entries.content:
Rainbow Daycare is a highly rated daycare located in a vibrant and well-off neighborhood in the city. It has been providing high-quality early education and loving care to children ages 6 months to 5 years.

The daycare is located in a spacious, colorful building designed specifically for young children. It features multiple age-appropriate classrooms, a large indoor play area, an outdoor play area and dedicated to activities such as arts and crafts, music and supports the cognitive, physical, social and emotional development of each child in its care.

entries.name: ## Classrooms

1. Baby (6 months - 1 year), class by teacher and director Neil Beary.

3. Early Preschool (2 - 3 years), class by Professor Kasper Culkin.
4. Preschool (3 - 5 years), teacher Clarence Morrison's class.

Each classroom has a lead teacher who work closely to implement the nursery's play-based curriculum. Daily activities include:

- Art and Crafts
- Music and movement.
